world.title: Folded
lines: The sky above is a pale blue, with white flecks of clouds. The water is a deep blue, with tiny ripples. Above, there is a thin, sharp line where the sea meets the sky. In the distance, a small, narrow path winds between the land and the sea. There is a cat, curled up on the shelf next to the ship, looking up at the clouds. The cat's eyes are one of the few things that are not dull in this place. The sun rises at this time of day, revealing a new world to the eye. In every crease, the world is folded.
